sensor_label_basis: Region/order aligned with the collaborator schema; STEP itself has no channel IDs. LF/PTC-02 and LF/PTC-03 share mounting bodies. JTC-A/B label two additional jacket-port assemblies.
limitations: Active heater length and boundaries are not separately modeled. Heating-leg length is not an active heater length.
Main swept loop fluid bore is not encoded. Local instrument spool bores differ from exit tube bores.
Surface contact references can be non-unique. All minimum-distance solver solutions are retained; a physical sensing junction is not identified.
LF coordinates locate modeled mounts, not distributed optical sensing extents.
Spline bend reconstructions have endpoint residuals; exact joined hydraulic centerline lengths are not established.
Cooler straight axes have a 0.271771 mm assembly offset. No source geometry has been healed.
